Cc: ops@healthly.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor activation & TIA window

Hi Stephanie / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We are going to move forward with activating a small analytics subprocessor (Aperture Analytics) for our integration test environment. Before we flip the switch we need two things confirmed from Redwood:

- a target activation window (we're proposing the week of 6/23)
- confirmation of the TIA/DTIA artifacts you will provide (sampling cadence, logging retention proof, and egress controls)

I've attached a short workbook that lists the minimum evidence items our legal team will accept (TIA-evidence-request.xlsx). Can you confirm which items are in scope and the expected delivery dates? We also have a limited DPA amendment to sign (DocuSign) that references the UK Addendum/IDTA for when we move to production.

Ask: Quick reply with (1) feasible activation window and (2) which evidence rows you can commit to by 6/20.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m call if helpful.

Best,
Emma Riley
Privacy Counsel | Healthly

Attachments: TIA-evidence-request.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
